name: Coordinate-Block Obstructions with Exponential Protected Depth
definition: Start from the fixed $627$-concept forbidden family $K=H\cup\{32\}$ formed from two certified $289$-concept rooted factors, their completed six-dimensional root cube, and one compatible tip. Replace coordinate $0$ by a block $E$ of size $m$ to obtain $K_m=W_E(K)$.
properties: Each $K_m$ is an ample pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness, has empty protected core, and satisfies $d_{\mathrm{prot}}(K_m)\ge2^m$. The isometric-dimension minus VC-dimension gap is constantly $18$. For $m>1$ it has negative coordinate reductions, so this family alone does not establish the terminal version.
